note: Full-hookup RV campground (plus tent sites) alongside the Tuckasegee River in Bryson City, near GSMNP; the River Front spaces back onto the river. Concrete pads, pet-friendly. --Claude
summary: Operator site + its booking engine: $55 (Fence Side, Nov 2026) to $75 (River Front, 2027) a night, standing 2-night minimum every season, open year-round, full hookups, coin laundry. Note cleaned (dropped restroom/shower/dump/pet list). Not stated: amperage, site count, max rig length, showers or dump station (left as derived).
flags: Website is a tourism listing (explorebrysoncity.com); the operator's own site with online booking is https://bearhuntercampground.com/.
Missing phone: the operator gives (828) 707-7604 (contact page and after-hours line).
Name: the operator calls it 'Bear Hunter Campground' (two words); the entry has 'Bearhunter Campground'.

Price gate: base $55/night (Fence Side, November 2026; $70 for 2027 peak nights) is over US$50, but the park is 14 km from the Great Smoky Mountains NP gateway (gateways.py), so the gate is lifted. Family has not stayed here.
Standing 2-night minimum in every season tested (November, January, May, July) - recorded in booking.min_stay; a 2-night standing minimum stays if marked.
